Intel (INTC) Shares Rose While Godsey & Gibb Associates Decreased Its Stake; Hollysys Automation Technolo (HOLI) Holder Fil LTD Raised Stake
June 15, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Fil Ltd increased its stake in Hollysys Automation Technolo (HOLI) by 43.28% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fil Ltd bought 344,451 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.14M shares of the energy company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $28.19 million, up from 795,915 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fil Ltd who had been investing in Hollysys Automation Technolo for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.40B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.77% or $1.16 during the last trading session, reaching $23.22. About 230,331 shares traded. Hollysys Automation Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ:HOLI) has risen 52.53% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 39.96% the S&P500. Some Historical HOLI News: 14/05/2018 – HOLLYSYS 3Q REV. $120.6M
Godsey & Gibb Associates decreased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Godsey & Gibb Associates sold 7,139 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.89% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 349,017 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $18.18M, down from 356,156 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Godsey & Gibb Associates who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $257.21 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.62% or $0.345 during the last trading session, reaching $55.195. About 23.81 million shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 52.90% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 40.33% the S&P500.
